headerDisplay: Connect a MOVA robot vacuum to Homebridge and Apple Home. Regional login outside EU/Germany is experimental and requires testing.
footerDisplay: Credentials are used only to sign in to the MOVA cloud. Never share passwords, tokens, full logs or your complete Homebridge configuration in support requests.

name.title: Plugin name
name.description: Name of the MOVA integration in Homebridge.

username.title: MOVA email address
username.description: Email address used to sign in to the MOVAhome app.

region.title: MOVA cloud region
enumNames: US cloud (experimental; Canadian accounts: also set country CA)
region.description: Select the cloud region used by your MOVAhome account, not the location of your Homebridge server. Other regions are never tried automatically. Only EU/Germany has been tested with this plugin; selecting a region does not guarantee login or model compatibility.

country.title: MOVA account country
country.description: Two-letter country code selected in your MOVAhome account (e.g. CA, US, DE, FR). Required for non-EU cloud regions. If left blank in EU, DE is retained for existing installations. Do not change the country of your account in the MOVAhome app just to test this plugin.

language.title: MOVA cloud request language
language.description: Language metadata sent to MOVA, not the Homebridge UI language. Automatic preserves the existing German requests / English regional header for EU/DE; other region/country combinations use English. For Canadian account testing, start with English.

experimentalModelSupport.title: Unknown MOVA model support
enumNames: Experimental full access (at your own risk)
experimentalModelSupport.description: For unverified MOVA models only. Diagnostic mode reads status and room count, sends no control commands and publishes no Matter accessory. Full access exposes the device experimentally; commands may differ between models.
